record.title: Tokenised collateral allocation and settlement — committee assessment
record.rationale: 9 decision gate(s) remain open. Resolve the named evidence, economic, legal, custody, cash, data and operating dependencies before recommending a pilot. Selected mechanisms: Multiple parties need a shared, consistently updated position or ownership state; Asset and cash actions need coordinated, conditional execution across participants.

pilotScope: One collateral agreement and one margin-call type
Check asset eligibility, valuation source, haircuts, concentration and encumbrance before allocation
Allocate in shadow mode; obtain custody acknowledgement before treating an asset as mobilised
Release only after obligation status and authority are confirmed; reconcile inventory, register and settlement records
architecture: Legal agreement and authoritative collateral register define rights, substitution and release conditions.
Collateral operations own eligibility, valuation, haircut and concentration adjudication; custody confirms control and availability.
A pre-pledge allocation proposal is distinct from pledge execution and release; settlement records retain separate accepted, delivered and released states.
Model settlement cash, fees and shortfall funding separately; do not treat tokenised collateral as cash.
Token representation is optional. Use it only if its measured shared-state or conditional-settlement benefit exceeds conventional workflow cost and control impact.
successMeasures: Time from margin call to confirmed allocation and delivery
Eligible collateral utilisation and substitution turnaround
Manual touchpoints, exceptions and reconciliation breaks
Settlement failures, stale-data blocks and recovery time

economicSummary.note: Annualised modeled differences over 120 events. Proposed values are assumption and are not measured outcomes. The primary objective is cost; material deteriorations require explicit acceptance. Net returns include implementation and run costs only when entered.

failureScenarios.name: Insufficient settlement cash
failureScenarios.expected: Block cash settlement, preserve both obligations and identify the funding owner.

failureScenarios.name: Ineligible collateral
failureScenarios.expected: Reject allocation against the governing eligibility and haircut rules; retain a reason code.

failureScenarios.name: Failed delivery
failureScenarios.expected: Keep the margin obligation open; do not mark collateral mobilised without source confirmation.

failureScenarios.name: Stale valuation or inventory data
failureScenarios.expected: Block allocation until an authoritative fresh observation is received.

failureScenarios.name: Reconciliation mismatch
failureScenarios.expected: Open a break across agreement, inventory, custody and settlement records; never silently repair.

scenarios.remediation: Settlement Operations: restore and independently confirm the cash source before resubmitting.

scenarios.name: Ineligible collateral
scenarios.outcome: Asset is ineligible under the selected agreement rules.
scenarios.remediation: Collateral Operations: select an asset that meets agreement criteria and retain the rejection reason.

events.detail: Asset is ineligible under the selected agreement rules.

scenarios.name: Failed delivery
scenarios.outcome: Delivery confirmation was not received; keep the obligation open and do not mark the asset mobilised.
scenarios.remediation: Custody Operations: query authoritative delivery status and retry only after state is known.

events.detail: BOND-001 reserved at haircut-adjusted value €760.000 against a €500.000 obligation.
Delivery confirmation was not received; keep the obligation open and do not mark the asset mobilised.

scenarios.name: Stale valuation data
scenarios.outcome: Asset valuation or inventory data is stale; refresh its source observation.
scenarios.remediation: Data Owner: fetch a fresh authorized valuation and inventory observation with source timestamp.

events.detail: Asset valuation or inventory data is stale; refresh its source observation.

scenarios.name: Reconciliation mismatch
scenarios.outcome: Reconciliation break: custody: observed AVAILABLE, expected DELIVERED. Preserve source records and route to the record owner.
scenarios.remediation: Operations: preserve all source observations and resolve with the agreement, inventory, custody and settlement owners.
